libs.note: BH-8172. The OTP step of the web-task lane, the page half of type_otp(): on the run's vault site only, and only when that site is on the allow-list, it finds the one-time-code input, types the code that type_otp (bin/lib/web-otp-action.mjs) makes at typing time, submits, and checks that the code form is gone. Slice C1 of #8172 applies it with lib_env_apply web-otp-step in the web-task lane.

knobs.note: How long the OTP step waits for the page to load after it submits the code. Past it the step answers `error: otp timed out after <n>s`. A value that is not an integer in 5..120 makes createOtpStep throw; it is never clamped. Read by createOtpStep as env WEB_TASK_OTP_STEP_TIMEOUT_S, fallback 20.
